releaseNotes:
# 24.11.4b [Alpha] / [Default]

## Fixes
- Leaderboards now actually leaderboard (for reals this time).

### Leaderboard Changes
- It now will always replace if the hits are less.
- It now will replace if the hits are the same but the boosts are less.
- It now will replace if the hits are the same and the boosts are the same but the close calls are less.

### Leaderboard Sorting
- It sorts only by hits and boosts with hits being the most important.
- Boosts are only used to break ties with hits.
- Close calls are not used in sorting.

*Also yes sadly this means I was incorrect, I will be refreshing leaderboards one last time apologies. Thanks for the patience.*
